200.description:
Administrative and hydrological context for a GeoJSON geometry from ACIS General: the county (5-digit FIPS, name, state, bbox), NCEI climate division, USGS HUC8 basins and NWS forecast office (county warning area) whose areas intersect the geometry's bounding box. Four small lookups in one call; a layer with no match is listed under `missing`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `basins` | object[] | USGS HUC8 basins; id is the 8-digit hydrologic unit code. |
| `climate_divisions` | object[] |  |
| `counties` | object[] |  |
| `forecast_offices` | object[] | NWS county warning areas; id is the office code (e.g. OHX). |
| `location` | object | Echo of the input geometry as the program understood it. |
| `missing` | object[] | Layers the source did not supply, instead of guessed values. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Milliseconds since the Unix epoch when this result was produced. |
| `sources` | object[] |  |
| `spatial_precision` | string | How closely the values describe the geometry: `polygon` = mean of grid cells whose centres fall inside it; `grid_cell` = the single 1/24-degree PRISM cell nearest the centroid (points and parcels smaller than a cell); `point` = a station or point lookup; `county` = county-level value. |
| `states` | string[] |  |

sources.name: ACIS GridData grid 21 (PRISM, NOAA Regional Climate Centers)

200.description:
Observed daily weather history for a GeoJSON geometry from the PRISM 4 km grid (ACIS GridData grid 21, contiguous US, 1981 to the latest published day): per-day precipitation (mm), max/min/mean temperature (degC) and growing degree days, plus a client-side summary (rain total, wet and dry days, longest dry spell, extremes, GDD total). Polygons are the mean of grid cells whose centres fall inside them (spatial_precision `polygon`); points and parcels smaller than a cell use the nearest cell (`grid_cell`). Windows up to 366 days; `end` defaults to yesterday and `start` to 30 days before it. Geometries outside the PRISM grid are refused as invalid_input/outside_coverage; -999 values are reported under `missing`, never guessed.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `days` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | string |  |
| `gdd` | number | Growing degree days (Fahrenheit degree-days, base gdd_base_f) as ACIS computes them. |
| `precip_mm` | number | Daily precipitation (mm); null where ACIS reported -999. |
| `tavg_c` | number |  |
| `tmax_c` | number |  |
| `tmin_c` | number |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
